g.text: Missing evaluations remain blank. Paper GBFS has only a five-map seven-box pilot, not an 82-map evaluation.
5-box confidence-aware (50) and risk-averse: RTX 3050 runs. Other historical runs use different devices/budgets.
7-box: Tesla T4; 360 s / 1,000,000 expansions for every method. Latest 37 maps are completed live-log records.
